answer: Let G admit a cut (A,B) with conductance phi small, A honest, B adversarial. The normalized Laplacian gap yields a spectral partition barrier: every personalized EigenTrust map P_alpha contracts mass across the cut, since its off-diagonal block norm is bounded by alpha plus phi, giving geometric attenuation. Hence adversarial weight cannot propagate through the honest manifold, even along paths likened to copper, river, or vine.
